purpose: Schema PRIOR for the dynamic-application runtime. Hints only. Fresh rendered DOM is authoritative. Nothing here is a selector contract or a script.

coverage.note: Singleton (Kendra Scott on BrassRing / Infinite Talent TGnewUI). Job details page -> 'Apply to job' -> 'Sign In' page (email + password, or 'Skip sign in') -> 'Privacy Policy' page: 'Note: You must AGREE to proceed.' with Agree/Disagree buttons. Agreeing to an employer policy requires the user's explicit permission, so I stopped there; the application form itself was NOT observed.

page_titles: VP, Digital Site Merchandising | Kendra Scott

job_details.apply_entry: button#applyFromDetailBtn 'Apply to job'; secondary buttons 'Easy Apply' (ui-id-1), 'Save', 'Send to friend'
job_details.spa: Angular single-page app; URL keeps #jobDetails=<jobid>_<siteid> across views, so URL is not a step identity

sign_in_gate.title: Sign In
controls: 'Skip sign in' button (group 'Skip sign in option')
sign_in_gate.note: 'Fields marked with an asterisk (*) are required.'

privacy_gate.title: Privacy Policy
privacy_gate.heading: Kendra Scott Employment Privacy Policy
privacy_gate.text: Note: You must AGREE to proceed. ... Last Updated: July 1, 2023 ... (California employees, contractors and job applicants policy)

step_patterns.identity_hint: document.title 'Privacy Policy', text 'You must AGREE to proceed', buttons Agree/Disagree

blockers.detail: Employer privacy policy must be agreed ('Agree') before the form renders. Not clicked.
blockers.human_action_needed: User reads and agrees to the Kendra Scott employment privacy policy (or authorises the runtime to do so), then the form can be observed.

blockers.detail: Sign-in gate can be skipped via 'Skip sign in'; account not required at this point.

runtime_observations: Clicking 'Apply to job' and 'Skip sign in' are non-submitting navigations; both worked via OpenCLI click (#applyFromDetailBtn, #ng-scope_BUTTON_1).
Step identity must come from document.title/headings, not the URL.
The 'Send to friend' and 'Save' buttons sit next to Apply; 'Send to friend' would send an email and must never be clicked.

inferred.form_unverified: BrassRing TGnewUI application pages are known to be multi-section (contact, resume upload/parse, questions, EEO) with 'Save and continue' between sections; UNVERIFIED here.

provider_hint.for_jev: brassring: expect three gates before the form: Apply to job -> Sign In (skippable) -> Privacy Policy (Agree required). Classify the privacy page as consent_required and stop for human decision in prepare-only mode. After consent, re-observe and map by label; never click 'Send to friend'.

edge_cases: Two apply controls exist ('Apply to job' and 'Easy Apply'); only 'Apply to job' was exercised.
The hidden frmSMSiteLoginAccount form posts to tgwebhost/SMSiteLoginAccount.aspx with a session id in the action; do not treat it as the application form.
